about: The official ScienceWorld evaluation split, transcribed from the repository's
goldpaths/goldpaths-all.zip. **Generated, not hand-written** -- see the generator
in tests/quality/test_scienceworld_dataset.py, which rebuilds this from the
archive and fails if the two disagree.
Why the split is in git and the archive is not: raw.githubusercontent.com is
blocked on this host and a branch URL is not a pin, so the archive could not be
provisioned reproducibly. Only the *identity* of the evaluation tasks is needed
at run time -- the gold action sequences are regenerated from the environment's
own API, which is what makes the oracle control check the environment rather than
